claim_ceiling: On the four pinned credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors (CAL-POS-1..4), K=4 fresh sessions, stdlib HTTP, one capture date, one egress ASN: (1) Part I replicates EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED (GATE-E3 PASS, M-N-SESSION-SCOPED-CONFIRMED=3/4, both independent stdlib paths agree on per-field value sets and session-scoped verdicts). The parent's failure on these anchors is attributable to an instrument/extraction certificate defect (GATE-C3), not representation loss. (2) Part II yields DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE with M-D1V-DEGENERACY-MODE=ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_COUPLING and secondary label FEASIBILITY-D1V-SINGLE-ANCHOR-TRANSPORT-COUPLED, satisfying the Director mandate's escape clause. The D1V population spans exactly one anchor (CAL-POS-2) because the frozen transport_signature couples to the rotating value on CAL-POS-1 (body-derived ETag) and CAL-POS-3 (token-bearing final_url), and CAL-POS-4 has NO_FIELD; this coupling is time-stable (M-TRANSPORT-COUPLING-STABILITY=UNCHANGED vs parent). The anchor-clustered bootstrap estimator is certified capable of non-degenerate bounds (GATE-F PASS: heterogeneous 2-anchor fixture LOW=1/3, UB97=1/2; 1-anchor null; homogeneous zero-width). Therefore the degeneracy is attributed to the population (structural transport-value coupling), not the estimator. Powering the guard-differential read (M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V with non-degenerate anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound) requires either a different anchor population with transport validators independent of the rotating value, or an instrument redesign decoupling body-derived validators from value rotation — neither authorized by this mandate (parent SB-05). C-FRESHNESS status remains EXPERIMENTAL per CC-B; no product promotion; no replay-by-assumption. All results scoped to CC-A (four anchors, one capture, one ASN). M-INVISIBLE-STALE-PREV=null (SB-04).
